title: Serena Williams helped build Jamaica school for 80 preschool children in 2016
summary_full: Serena Williams has taken an admirable step towards education by contributing to the Salt Marsh Basic School in Trelawny, Jamaica. This school provides free preschool education to local children, significantly improving their access to learning. By physically participating in the building process alongside other volunteers, Williams showcased the value of community collaboration in fostering educational growth and ensuring a safe space for the children.
